reason.message: Cannot find a process with the process identifier 3504.

observedMechanism: In this run, a CDP-advertised auxiliary PID was not found by the subsequent Windows lookup and was absent from the following CDP inventory. This establishes a concrete enumeration/observation disagreement consistent with process-lifetime change; it is not an access-denied result.
priorCases: Earlier missing ProcessorMetrics and on-device-model IDs have no retained native error record, so their exact causes remain unproven and their failures remain failures.
validity: Missing ID kept in missingIds and raw measurement failed. No zero counter, process exclusion, retry or browser-feature disable was used. Diagnostic following-inventory call does not supply the missing memory counter.
performance: Additional query occurs only after a gap; this is a single diagnostic trial, not a benchmark comparison or performance acceptance.
